name: Christmas Conservatory
target_customer: Adults seeking a refined, non-character festive card

summary.style: Hand-painted festive watercolour stationery with original botanical and winter storytelling motifs, balancing a refined handmade feel with clear card-front readability.
summary.linework: Very fine, selective charcoal-pencil or ink accents; no heavy outlines.; Gently irregular, organic and hand-rendered, used sparingly to define small details.
summary.detail: Moderate detail concentrated in one clear focal illustration, with secondary marks kept airy and restrained for reliable home printing.
summary.palette: Muted heritage Christmas palette of evergreen, sage, olive, cranberry, brick red, warm brown, cream, soft grey and frosty blue-grey; red used as a restrained accent. (full colour)
summary.mood: Warm, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly celebratory.

concepts.target_customer: Adults seeking a refined, non-character festive card
concepts.short_description: A folded printable Christmas card centred on an abundant winter citrus and evergreen arrangement, ideal for sending polished seasonal wishes to friends, family, neighbours or colleagues.
key_features: Folded A4 or US Letter home-print layout
Warm-white background with generous writing space
concepts.visual_direction_summary: A light, elegant botanical route with an old-fashioned Christmas larder feel: winter greenery, citrus and restrained cranberry accents form a softly asymmetrical watercolour arrangement around a clean greeting.

visual_route.scene: Warm-white paper with airy seasonal foliage vignette
visual_route.composition: Asymmetrical lower-corner arrangement with greeting space above
visual_route.palette_emphasis: Evergreen, cream, warm brown, citrus gold and cranberry
visual_route.typography_approach: Classic serif greeting in spacious upper centre
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Clementines nestled among cedar, pinecones and velvet ribbon

concepts.preview_brief: Portrait card front with a ribbon-tied cluster of clementines, cedar sprigs and pinecones rising softly from one lower corner on warm-white paper. An original classic serif Christmas greeting sits in the open upper centre, with a refined, peaceful handmade mood.

concepts.target_customer: Families and adults who enjoy nostalgic Christmas scenes
concepts.short_description: A folded printable Christmas card featuring a peaceful snowy village at dusk, made for sending warm seasonal wishes with a nostalgic storybook atmosphere.
key_features: Folded A4 or US Letter home-print layout
Clear front greeting and uncluttered interior
concepts.visual_direction_summary: A wide, storybook winter route using a tiny illuminated village beneath a pale evening sky. The panoramic scene is quiet and spacious, with warm window light providing a gentle festive counterpoint to cool snow.

visual_route.scene: Rolling hills beneath a pale winter evening sky
visual_route.composition: Low panoramic village band with open sky for greeting
visual_route.lighting: Blue-hour snowlight with warm window glow
visual_route.palette_emphasis: Blue-grey, cream, evergreen and small amber accents
visual_route.typography_approach: Delicate handwritten greeting across open evening sky
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Winding snow path leading to a tiny lantern-lit chapel

concepts.preview_brief: Landscape card front showing a small snow-covered village along the lower edge, with a winding path leading towards a warmly lit chapel lantern. The pale blue-grey dusk sky leaves ample room for an original delicate handwritten greeting, creating a calm Christmas Eve mood.

concepts.target_customer: Adults and families who favour serene nature-led cards
concepts.short_description: A folded printable Christmas card with a graceful swan gliding across a wintry woodland lake, offering a serene alternative to traditional festive characters and busy holiday scenes.
key_features: Folded A4 or US Letter home-print layout
Ample room for a personal handwritten message
concepts.visual_direction_summary: A serene nature route centred on still water, snowy reeds and one graceful bird. Minimal cranberry berries and evergreen reflections introduce Christmas colour while preserving a spacious, quietly celebratory card front.

visual_route.scene: Frozen woodland lake with snowy reeds
visual_route.composition: Swan centred on reflective water with tall clear upper space
visual_route.lighting: Pale pearl daylight after fresh snowfall
visual_route.palette_emphasis: Cream, frosty blue-grey, sage and restrained cranberry
visual_route.typography_approach: Small elegant serif greeting in upper third
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Swan gliding past a floating evergreen wreath

concepts.preview_brief: Portrait card front with a graceful mute swan gliding over a pale reflective lake, passing a small floating evergreen wreath amid snowy reeds. A compact original serif greeting rests in the clear upper third, giving the scene a peaceful and hopeful Christmas feel.

pages.title: Christmas Conservatory
pages.concept: An elegant botanical Christmas front with a spacious classic greeting above a softly asymmetrical winter citrus arrangement.
pages.artwork_description: Warm-white card front with the exact greeting “Merry Christmas” in a classic serif at the spacious upper centre. From the lower left corner rises an abundant but airy arrangement of three clementines tied with a muted cranberry velvet ribbon, cedar and pine sprigs, two warm-brown pinecones, a few olive leaves and restrained cranberry accents. The foliage fades gently towards the centre, leaving the greeting clearly legible.
pages.generation_prompt: Portrait Christmas card front. Exact title text: “Merry Christmas” in a spacious classic serif at upper centre. A softly asymmetrical lower-left botanical vignette: exactly three clementines gathered with a muted cranberry velvet ribbon, cedar sprigs, pine sprigs, two pinecones, olive leaves and a few restrained cranberry berries. Keep the upper half open and the arrangement light and graceful, with foliage rising softly inward from the corner.
pages.production_notes: Verify the greeting is spelled exactly “Merry Christmas” and remains high-contrast and legible. Keep all focal artwork inside broad safe margins; retain open warm-white space in the upper centre. Use moderate pigment coverage for home printing.

pages.title: Inside Greeting
pages.concept: A largely open writing panel carrying a short printed Christmas wish and two subtle botanical corner accents.
pages.artwork_description: Warm-white inside panel with the exact printed message “Wishing you a peaceful Christmas” in a small classic serif near the upper centre. A tiny cedar-and-clementine-leaf sprig rests in the lower left corner, balanced by a faint single cranberry-and-cedar accent in the upper right. The central and lower areas remain clear for a handwritten message.
pages.generation_prompt: Portrait card inside panel. Exact text: “Wishing you a peaceful Christmas” in a small elegant classic serif near upper centre. Add a very small cedar sprig with one clementine leaf in the lower-left corner and a faint minimal cranberry-and-cedar accent in the upper-right corner. Preserve extensive blank writing space across the centre and lower panel.
pages.production_notes: Verify the exact message spelling and ensure it is short, centred and clearly readable. Keep at least two-thirds of the panel open for handwriting. Decorative accents must not approach the fold or trim.

pages.title: Christmas Conservatory Back
pages.concept: A discreet coordinated back panel with a small botanical maker-style flourish and no branding.
pages.artwork_description: Warm-white back panel with a miniature botanical posy centred near the lower edge: one small clementine, cedar tips, an olive leaf, a pinecone and a short trailing cranberry ribbon. Above it is a small unadorned serif line reading “Christmas Conservatory”. The remaining panel is clean and understated.
pages.generation_prompt: Portrait card back panel. Exact small text: “Christmas Conservatory” in a restrained classic serif above a miniature lower-centre botanical posy. Posy contains one small clementine, cedar tips, one olive leaf, one pinecone and a short muted cranberry velvet ribbon tail. Keep the rest of the panel clean, quiet and unbranded.
pages.production_notes: Verify the product-name spelling exactly. Do not add logos, URLs, trademarks or extra text. Keep the posy compact and safely clear of folds and trim. Include the separate printing and folding guide as a non-artwork deliverable, explaining duplex print settings and folding after trimming if required.

selected_pages.reason: First content page (card-front): sets the core illustration style.
A different page type (card-inside) tests a different layout and activity structure.
A later page (card-back, p3) checks the shared style stays consistent across the product.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Hand-painted festive watercolour stationery with original botanical and winter storytelling motifs, balancing a refined handmade feel with clear card-front readability.; line weight: Very fine, selective charcoal-pencil or ink accents; no heavy outlines.; line quality: Gently irregular, organic and hand-rendered, used sparingly to define small details.; detail level: Moderate detail concentrated in one clear focal illustration, with secondary marks kept airy and restrained for reliable home printing.; character language: Softly naturalistic storybook characters with rounded silhouettes, subtle facial features and understated expressive gestures.; background density: Predominantly clean warm-white space; any scenic detail is contained, lightly layered and allowed to recede behind the focal point.; composition: Centred or softly asymmetrical focal hierarchy with generous breathing room and a clearly reserved area for an original greeting; framed vignettes may use broad unprinted borders.; palette: Muted heritage Christmas palette of evergreen, sage, olive, cranberry, brick red, warm brown, cream, soft grey and frosty blue-grey; red used as a restrained accent.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Transparent layered washes with gentle wet-on-dry modelling, soft cool winter shadows and occasional warm accents; never glossy or digitally airbrushed.; texture: Fine cold-pressed paper grain, mottled watercolour pigment, delicate dry-brush foliage marks and subtle hand-painted variation.; mood: Warm, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly celebratory..

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a solid or softly textured coloured background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It must look like a finished, retail-quality greeting card design, not a colouring page or worksheet. Design three coordinated portrait panels for an A4 or US Letter folded card, with a warm-white ground, broad safe margins, and no essential artwork near folds or trim.
